entities.summary:
The Museum of Independence is a museum in Warsaw, Poland. It was established on 30 January 1990 as the Museum of the History of Polish Independence and Social Movements and is located in the former Przebendowski Palace at al. 'Solidarity' 62, but it also has these branches:X Pavilion Museum at the Warsaw Citadel
Museum of Pawiak Prison
Mausoleum of Struggle and Martyrdom
